config.content:
## Vincari CAPD demo

Surgical computer-assisted physician documentation telemetry (`service.name: vincari-capd`) in this Serverless Observability project.

### App

Open the Vercel demo, sign an operative note, then return here via Discover / APM deep links.

### ES|QL

```esql
FROM logs-*
| WHERE service.name == "vincari-capd"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 50
```

---
*Unaffiliated demo. Not a Microsoft / Nuance / Vincari product.*
